dax_formula: Total Sales = SUM('Amazon Sales Data'[Total Sales])
Total Quantity = SUM('Amazon Sales Data'[Quantity])
Average Unit Price = AVERAGE('Amazon Sales Data'[Unit Price])
Sales per Unit = DIVIDE([Total Sales], [Total Quantity])
notes: Realized price per unit after discount

dax_formula: % of Total Sales = DIVIDE([Total Sales], CALCULATE([Total Sales], ALL('Amazon Sales Data')))
notes: Share of grand total; use in category/region breakdowns

dax_formula: Total Orders = DISTINCTCOUNT('Amazon Sales Data'[Order ID])
Average Order Value = DIVIDE([Total Sales], [Total Orders])
Cancelled Orders = CALCULATE([Total Orders], 'Amazon Sales Data'[Order Status] = "Cancelled")
Delivered Orders = CALCULATE([Total Orders], 'Amazon Sales Data'[Order Status] = "Delivered")
Processing Orders = CALCULATE([Total Orders], 'Amazon Sales Data'[Order Status] = "Processing")
Shipped Orders = CALCULATE([Total Orders], 'Amazon Sales Data'[Order Status] = "Shipped")
Cancellation Rate % = DIVIDE([Cancelled Orders], [Total Orders])
Total Discount Amount = SUMX('Amazon Sales Data', 'Amazon Sales Data'[Unit Price] * 'Amazon Sales Data'[Quantity] * 'Amazon Sales Data'[Discount])
notes: Discount value given back to customers

dax_formula: Avg Discount % = AVERAGE('Amazon Sales Data'[Discount])
Returned Orders = CALCULATE([Total Orders], 'Amazon Sales Data'[Return Status] IN {"Yes", "Returned"})
notes: Handles both return-flag values in the raw data

dax_formula: Return Rate % = DIVIDE([Returned Orders], [Total Orders])
Average Rating = AVERAGE('Amazon Sales Data'[Rating])
Rated Orders = COUNTROWS(FILTER('Amazon Sales Data', NOT ISBLANK('Amazon Sales Data'[Rating])))
notes: Count of orders that actually received a rating

dax_formula: Sales LY = CALCULATE([Total Sales], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR('Date'[Date]))
notes: Requires a proper Date table marked as a Date table, related to Order Date

dax_formula: Sales YoY % = DIVIDE([Total Sales] - [Sales LY], [Sales LY])
Sales MTD = TOTALMTD([Total Sales], 'Date'[Date])
Sales YTD = TOTALYTD([Total Sales], 'Date'[Date])
Sales QTD = TOTALQTD([Total Sales], 'Date'[Date])
